title: Git data to dashboard Space
description: Pulls a data repo from git (path only), has Claude read the files (parquet/csv/json) and build a dashboard, then creates or updates a Space on the hub.

config.inputs:
repo|Data repository (https)|text||*
ref|Branch or tag|text|
folder|Folder with the data|text|data
space|Space name|text|sales-dashboard|*
visibility|Who can open it|select|private,public

config.prompt:
The data lives at this path (a pointer, read it yourself with your tools: parquet via pandas/pyarrow or duckdb, csv, json):
{{input}}

1. Inspect the files: schema, row counts, date range. Install nothing globally; use `python -m pip install --user pandas pyarrow` only if missing.
2. Compute the 4-6 numbers and 3-4 charts that matter most.
3. Write ONE self-contained folder `dashboard/` in your working folder with `index.html` (inline CSS/JS, charts as inline SVG or Chart.js from cdnjs, no data fetched at view time; embed the aggregated numbers as JSON in the page; never embed raw rows).
4. Answer with 3 bullets of findings, then as the LAST line: `OUTPUT: ` followed by the full path of the dashboard folder.

config.name: {{data.space}}
config.title: Dashboard: {{data.space}}
config.description: Built from {{data.repo}} by a Works flow

config.text: Nodes pass paths, not content. Add Send email (Outlook) after Publish to mail the link, or a Start: schedule node to refresh the Space every Monday (same name = new revision).
